# zerocopy

Shared immutable collections. Reads are local; tasks are optional.

Source: https://github.com/natanelia/zerocopy/commit/62b0cbd1f55c703c6fe98b7d10e68896cfb3827c

- [Get started](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/getting-started.md): Share state with a worker. Read it directly on both threads.
- [How sharing works](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/mental-model.md): One writer, immutable snapshots, and local reads. A model you can reason about.
- [Collections & types](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/collections.md): Maps, lists, sets, typed JSON, and nested collections.
- [State & subscriptions](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/sessions.md): Connect workers and publish new snapshots without a task system.
- [Your own transport](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/transport.md): Use shared snapshots with an existing message protocol.
- [Optional tasks](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/tasks.md): Schedule a whole calculation. Keep individual reads local.
- [Workers & pools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/workers.md): Owned workers, existing workers, pools, MessagePorts, and SharedWorkers.
- [Redux](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/redux.md): Keep your store. Share selected collections with workers.
- [TanStack](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/tanstack.md): Collection wrappers and cache helpers, with their current limits.
- [Memory & ownership](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/memory.md): Understand storage, retained snapshots, and explicit compaction.
- [Recorded benchmarks](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/benchmarks.md): All recorded results, slower workloads, and methods. No selected-only results.
- [Migration](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/migration.md): Format and lifetime changes for existing users.
- [Choose a use case](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/use-cases.md): Where sharing helps, where it does not, and which alternatives to consider.
- [Live log explorer](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/log-explorer.md): One working example: search, summarize, and inspect a large shared stream.
- [Large tables & dashboards](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/data-tables.md): Multiple independent views of the same large, changing table.
- [Graphs & developer tools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/graphs.md): Stable versions for traversal, layout, and diagnostics.
- [Simulation & world state](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/simulations.md): Separate simulation ownership from analysis and rendering.
- [Product catalogs & filtering](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/analytics.md): Read stock directly and filter a large catalog in workers.
- [Maps & spatial tools](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/maps.md): Keep the map editable while workers inspect its data.
- [Editors & history](https://natanelia.github.io/zerocopy/previews/pr-14/0a08c74454bcf5708ad5ebbf72caf5d59e559415/markdown/editors.md): Read an earlier version without stopping new edits.
